description: Valeurs nationales de référence de risque ferroviaire établies par la Commission européenne is a dataset listed in SNCF Open Data, an open data portal of a railway operator, published or maintained by SNCF. Valeurs nationales de référence de risque ferroviaire établies par la Commission européenne en fonction des performances de chaque État membre dans le secteur ferroviaire. Coverage: France. The portal files it under Informations institutionnelles. Its keywords are Sécurité, Accidents, Union européenne. The portal shows 2017-05-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Database License (ODbL) (https://data.sncf.com/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sncf-open-data-portal.
